summary: Greenland Energy Co filed an 8-K reporting a registered direct public offering of common stock, pre-funded warrants, and common warrants, raising ~$70M gross proceeds. The offering consisted of 16.25M shares at $4.00/share with one common warrant each, plus 1.25M pre-funded warrants. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. The filing is a routine capital raise with no special-situation structure such as a tender offer, going-private, or strategic review. No board recommendation or advisor is named. The transaction is an ordinary shelf takedown and does not trigger a special-situations category.
